{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 生存模式","id":"gh:1334126047","install_available":false,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-survival","slug":"XDzzzzzZyq/dsh-survival","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","minecraft","minecraft-clientside"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 生存模式"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH 生存模式"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 🍗 **MC原版生存，今天吃什么？**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"在 DeepSeek Harness 中体验**MC原版生存**：MC 原版生存机制 + MC 风格 UI。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 这是什么"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"把一次会话变成一场方块世界生存（**agent 角色与标准模式完全一致**，仅追加一段系统提示，告诉 agent 何时请示吃饭/睡觉）："},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **新机制**（宿主端引擎 `survival-engine`，按 MC 规则结算）：
